tools.name: get_restaurant_overview
tools.title: Get restaurant overview
tools.description: Return the restaurant linked to the signed-in account, with today's order count and revenue.

tools.name: list_recent_orders
tools.title: List recent orders
tools.description: List the most recent orders for the signed-in user's restaurant, newest first. Optionally filter by status.

limit.description: How many orders to return (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: get_sales_summary
tools.title: Get sales summary
tools.description: Summarise sales for the signed-in user's restaurant over the last N days: revenue, order count, average order value, and a per-day breakdown.

days.description: Number of days to look back (1-90, default 7).

tools.name: list_menu_items
tools.title: List menu items
tools.description: List menu items for the signed-in user's restaurant, optionally filtered by category or a name search.

category.description: Exact category name to filter by.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the item name.

limit.description: How many items to return (1-100, default 50).

tools.name: list_low_stock_inventory
tools.title: List low stock inventory
tools.description: List inventory items for the signed-in user's restaurant that are at or below their reorder level.

limit.description: How many items to return (1-100, default 50).
